objective: Operationalize automatic test generation/strengthening across the repository under a controlled authorization boundary.

controlled_pipeline_design.philosophy: From runtime/foundation/verification/strengthening.py:8: 'The goal is NOT autonomous uncontrolled test generation and NEVER score-chasing. Every action originates from classified survivor / failure evidence, and every class-B/C/E case is explicitly refused.'
controlled_pipeline_design.production_modification: NEVER autonomous (line 33). Test-file modification is gated by explicit approval boundary (line 34).
controlled_pipeline_design.loop_contract: Before -> Targeted change -> Targeted verification (C42.28 bridge, never a full campaign) -> After -> hypothesis validated?
controlled_pipeline_design.automation_boundary: First version: detect -> diagnose -> propose -> validate. Production code never autonomously modified.

survivor_classification_taxonomy.CLASS_A: genuine behavioral weakness — potential strengthening candidate
survivor_classification_taxonomy.CLASS_B: equivalent / observable-equivalent behavior — DO NOT chase
survivor_classification_taxonomy.CLASS_C: defensive / unreachable / infrastructure-related — DO NOT manufacture tests for score
survivor_classification_taxonomy.CLASS_D: infrastructure/measurement problem — repair measurement before interpreting behavior
survivor_classification_taxonomy.CLASS_E: ambiguous / design / production-defect candidate — escalate for human review

human_authorization_boundary.evidence: strengthening_pipeline.py:138 requires_human_authorization field; line 442 enforces authorization check
human_authorization_boundary.controlled_pipeline_only: The discover→propose→authorize→validate→record pipeline is the only path; no autonomous modifications
human_authorization_boundary.verdict: Authorization boundary is enforced at the pipeline level, not just documented

validation_requirements_for_generated_te.meaningful_assertion: at least one assert statement testing behavior (not mere execution)
validation_requirements_for_generated_te.independent_pass: passes without ordering or state dependencies
validation_requirements_for_generated_te.incremental_value: increases killed/covered count or demonstrates behavioral distinction
validation_requirements_for_generated_te.mutation_validation: survives at least one targeted mutation where applicable

evidence_for_existing_pipeline.historical_certification: C53 (commit 358a30f7 'M9-C53: Automatic Test Generation & Evidence-Driven Strengthening (CERTIFIED)')

anti_pattern_audit.anti_pattern_5_certification_by_implemen: AVOIDED — pipeline exists with explicit authorization boundary, not just code
anti_pattern_audit.anti_pattern_8_deleting_capabilities: AVOIDED — no production or test code modified by this milestone
anti_pattern_audit.production_autonomy: FORBIDDEN — production code modifications never happen autonomously
